title: BUKLOD Academy of Higher Learning - Internal Quality and Curriculum Framework
scope: Design, delivery, assessment, learner support and verifiable non-formal theological learning completions using current BUKLOD modules
exclusions: Social Wall and Connect community activity as academic credit
AdMob, QMP, points claims and purchases
Licensure, ordination and academic degree conferral
evidence_rule: UC thresholds plus recursively verified direct prerequisites plus exact published source competencies; no synthetic completions.

source_modules.existing: Daily Bible assignments, reviewed submissions and canonical BP source linkage
outcomes: Explain the assigned passage accurately
Provide a contextual and original personal reflection
source_modules.protection: Never award for assignment view or unreviewed reflection

source_modules.existing: Daily Word/devotional reward submissions and approved reviewer state
outcomes: Summarize a devotional's Biblical idea
Apply a distinct reflection to a daily context
source_modules.protection: Do not double-count the same Daily Reading evidence as Word

source_modules.existing: Bible chapter reading, reflection and chapter-check workflows
outcomes: Identify chapter context and genre
Explain major themes through a verified question or reflection
source_modules.protection: Opening or scrolling a chapter is never academic verification

source_modules.existing: Children's Story lessons, questions and evidence-based teaching session
outcomes: Retell a story faithfully and answer comprehension questions
Apply age-appropriate pedagogy with consent-protected evidence where teaching is claimed
source_modules.protection: Never expose child's identity, photo or group details on public certificates

source_modules.existing: KL chapters, quiz sets, attempts and required chapter comments
outcomes: Interpret narrative and demonstrate critical comprehension
Submit original reflection/comment before unlocking further chapters
source_modules.protection: No credit for mere read-time or chapter unlocking

source_modules.existing: ABaKa canonical A-Z/preliminaries, verified growth progress
outcomes: Demonstrate doctrinal foundations with Scripture-grounded answers
source_modules.protection: A-Z coverage must map to actual published curriculum; no synthetic catch-up

outcomes: Compare intermediate doctrinal claims using cited passages
source_modules.protection: Unpublished or draft doctrinal units are ineligible

outcomes: Apply advanced doctrinal reasoning with contextual analysis
Defend a theological interpretation with fair counterargument
source_modules.protection: Disputed doctrinal conclusions go to human academic governance

source_modules.existing: Official BUKLOD Formation 101-104 sequential lessons and covenant gates
outcomes: Demonstrate foundational Christian formation
Complete authentic ordered covenant and lesson gates
evidence: stage progress and signed/validated covenant if required

outcomes: Demonstrate servant leadership and ethical application
source_modules.protection: Known unverified lesson/source gap blocks leadership completion

outcomes: Demonstrate role-specific ministry competence
Apply proper role and service ethics
source_modules.protection: One assigned role track, not every specialty; never imply ordination

outcomes: Plan and evaluate responsible mission service
source_modules.protection: Incomplete mission or unpublished content cannot be credited

source_modules.existing: DEV SALIKSIK research design, citation review, original paper and defense
outcomes: Develop a reproducible research question and method
Cite valid Biblical and external sources
Defend the conclusion fairly with limitations
source_modules.protection: No UC for submission alone; high-stakes human governance for flagged issues

competency_matrix.domain: Christology and the work of Christ
Biblical genres, OT and NT interpretation
Research design, ethics and primary evidence
